title: The Vector of the Deep
author: Lena Ashgrove
blurb: Wendell Fairweather, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
